biography: I am a senior level role player in the arena of Property Investment and Development with over 25 years executive grade industry expertise. Focused on deal origination, strategic land acquisition, bulk services infrastructure, top structure development, portfolio management and investment strategy, I have successfully supported deal initiation and delivery on numerous projects in the commercial, industrial and residential arenas. Now working for Microsoft, and focused on the evolving Data Center sector I am able to bring my extensive experience to this niche market. I was a lead team member and CIO of an AIM listed property development fund between 2007 and 2011 where I was instrumental in fund raising, investment strategy, project delivery and managing investor relations. Proven ability to lead diverse teams and multiple stakeholders to project success through complex development life cycles.
